evidence: Ran blind_review.py over 45 committed result documents produced by other cohorts, read from their branches by Git object id, plus 7 in-memory injected-defect variants whose ground truth is SHOULD_REJECT by construction (52 candidates total). Criteria digests for every unit were recorded into criteria-precommit.json before any packet was built, and every record shows criteria_digest_matches_precommit true. Each candidate produced two packets with different digests: the blind packet strips verdict, evidence, limitations, producer block and generated_at; the narrative packet adds the producer verdict, evidence prose, limitations and state claim. Measured divergence: 4 of 52 candidates, all 4 injected defects whose detection required verification the producer's narrative claimed to have done (corrupt artifact digest, removed tests evidence, manifest/result byte disagreement, mutable HEAD locator). All 45 unmodified real candidates produced identical ACCEPT verdicts in both arms, so the divergence is not an artefact of a strawman reviewer. Calibration on the ground-truth-labelled set: blind arm 7 of 7 correct (1.0), narrative-anchored arm 3 of 7 correct (0.4286); the narrative arm caught only the three defects that violate the result contract structurally and missed all four that require independent verification. Hypothesis PASS: the arms diverge and the blind arm is strictly better calibrated. 14 unit tests passed under python -I, including proof that the blind packet contains no producer conclusion text, that injection never mutates the base candidate, and that the narrative arm verifies everything when the producer claims no PASS.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A reviewer that receives frozen criteria without producer conclusions reaches a different and better-calibrated verdict than one that sees the narrative.
limitations: Both reviewers are deterministic rule-based procedures, not language models. The measurement is therefore about criteria-only versus narrative-anchored decision procedures, and it does not measure how a language-model reviewer would behave.

No subagent or cross-model-family spawn tool is exposed in this runtime's tool set, so the cross-family independent reviewer arm required by the independence constraint could not be executed; the single-family, rule-based arm is the whole of what was run.

Ground truth exists only for the 7 injected candidates. The 45 unmodified candidates are deliberately left unlabelled because the rule that would label them is the rule the blind reviewer applies, and counting them would be circular.

An earlier version of the tests-evidence criterion accepted only .txt, .json, .jsonl and .log artifacts and therefore rejected 12 real units whose recorded outcome is an evidence.md; the criterion was widened to recognise committed .md, .out and .csv outcome documents before the reported measurement, which reduced rather than increased the measured divergence.
Divergence is measured against the specific seven-defect injection catalogue; a different catalogue would move both arms' accuracy.
